original: In ancient times the territory of the Coast formed part of the Roman Empire, as evidenced by the presence of numerous patrician villas, the most extensive of which is located in Minori.
translated: In der Antike war das Küstengebiet Teil des Römischen Reiches, wie die Anwesenheit zahlreicher Patriziervillen zeigt, von denen die umfangreichste in Minori liegt.
